groups.name: Seas of the world
groups.why: All seas. The Ionian Sea sits between Greece and Italy, and the Ionian mode borrowed the region's name. Aegean is one vowel away from Aeolian. Nice try.

groups.name: Modes with a minor 3rd
groups.why: Each has a flat 3rd above its tonic. Ionian, Lydian and Mixolydian are the major-3rd modes, so Ionian went swimming instead.

groups.name: Chord qualities beyond plain major and minor
groups.why: Augmented = major 3rd + sharp 5. Diminished = flat 3 + flat 5. Sus = the 3rd is swapped for a 2nd or 4th. Dominant 7 = major triad + flat 7.

groups.name: Army ranks
groups.why: All US Army ranks. MAJOR looked like a chord quality, but it was on duty. A major outranks a captain; in music it outranks nobody.

groups.name: Tempo markings
groups.why: Allegro = fast and lively, andante = walking pace, adagio = slow, presto = very fast.

groups.name: Dynamic markings
groups.why: Forte = loud, piano = soft, crescendo = get louder, sforzando = a sudden strong accent. The instrument's full name, pianoforte, means soft-loud.

groups.name: Italian foods
groups.why: PESTO is one letter away from PRESTO. Delicious, but it will not tell you how fast to play.

groups.name: Played with a bow
groups.why: All bowed strings (a fiddle is a violin with a different attitude). The piano has strings too, but felt hammers strike them, so it stayed with the dynamics.

groups.name: Note values
groups.why: Whole, half, quarter, eighth: each is half as long as the one before. QUARTER means one fourth, not four, so it skipped the fours.

groups.name: Twos
groups.why: Dyad = a two-note chord, duplet = two notes in the time of three, duet = two performers, pair = two of anything.

groups.name: Threes
groups.why: Triad = three-note chord, triplet = three in the time of two, trio = three players. TREBLE comes from the Latin for triple and means threefold, which is why it is not just a clef.

groups.name: Fours
groups.why: Quartet = four players, tetrachord = four-note scale segment, quadruplet = four in the time of three, quatrain = a four-line verse.

groups.name: Fish
groups.why: All fish. PIKE is also a diving position, but it never made the music half of the sports list.

groups.name: Things with a neck
groups.why: A violin's neck holds the fingerboard. Giraffe, bottle and shirt have necks too. The piano has no neck, just a lot of keys.

groups.name: Things with keys
groups.why: Piano keys, a map key (the legend), a lock's key and the Florida Keys islands.

groups.name: Music words that are also sports words
groups.why: Pitch: a soccer field or a note's highness. Score: points or printed music. Run: a baseball run or a fast scale. Bar: the crossbar or a measure.

groups.name: Do-Re-Mi, Sound of Music style
groups.why: From 'Do-Re-Mi': doe a deer, ray a drop of golden sun, far a long way to run, tea a drink with jam and bread. Solfege by pun.

groups.name: Playing card ranks
groups.why: Card ranks. ACE can be spelled with music letters, but it is only three letters long, so it missed the cut.

groups.name: Spelled only with A to G, six letters or more
groups.why: Every letter is a note name, so you could play each word on the piano. Cabbage is C-A-B-B-A-G-E.

groups.name: Hidden composers
groups.why: BACHelor, iceBERG (Alban Berg), birdCAGE (John Cage), HOLSTer (Gustav Holst, The Planets).

groups.name: Major 7th chords
groups.why: Major triad + major 7th, a half step under the octave. In the room: 'the 7th butts the root.' Cmaj7 = C E G B.

groups.name: Dominant 7th chords
groups.why: Major triad + flat 7: the V7 of a key (G7 in C, D7 in G, C7 in F, A7 in D). Add a flat 9 and you have the classic dominant color.

groups.name: Half-diminished (ø7): vii7 in a major key
groups.why: Diminished triad + minor 7th. That is vii7 in C, G, F and D major. Not °7: a fully diminished 7th needs a diminished 7th on top.

groups.name: Same °7 chord, four names
groups.why: A °7 is stacked minor 3rds, so B-D-F-A♭ repeats every three half steps. Whichever note you call the root, it is the same four notes.

groups.name: Archery gear
groups.why: Archery. QUIVER is one vowel from QUAVER, and BOW belongs to strings players too, but here it shoots.

groups.name: Yarn and fabric crafts
groups.why: CROCHET (no T) is yarn work. CROTCHET (with a T) is a British quarter note.

groups.name: Ornaments
groups.why: Trill = rapid alternation with the note above. Mordent = quick flick to a neighbor and back. Appoggiatura = a leaning note that steals time. Acciaccatura = a crushed grace note, as fast as possible.

groups.name: British note names
groups.why: UK names: semibreve = whole note, minim = half, crotchet = quarter, quaver = eighth.

groups.name: Parent key: C major (all white keys)
groups.why: All white keys. D Dorian and G Mixolydian share C, along with A Aeolian and F Lydian. Same notes, different home base.

groups.name: Parent key: G major (one sharp)
groups.why: Every one uses F♯. C Lydian's raised 4th is that F♯, which puts its parent at G.

groups.name: Parent key: F major (one flat)
groups.why: Every one uses B♭. C Mixolydian's parent is F: same notes as F major, starting on C.

groups.name: Parent key: D major (two sharps)
groups.why: F♯ and C♯ in all four. G Lydian's raised 4th is C♯, so its parent is D.

groups.name: Parts of a shoe
groups.why: Shoe parts. SOLE also sounds like soul music, but it stays on the ground.

groups.name: Drum kit pieces
groups.why: Snare, cymbal, hi-hat, tom: standard drum kit gear.

groups.name: Parts of the ear
groups.why: Hammer, anvil and stirrup are nicknames for the three tiny middle-ear bones. The cochlea turns vibration into nerve signals. The hammer looked like a piano part, but it is in your head.

groups.name: Piano parts you can see with the lid closed
groups.why: Lid, fallboard (the cover over the keys), music desk and keys are all on the outside. The hammers live inside the piano.

groups.name: Pirate gear
groups.why: Pirate essentials. Not a homophone in the bunch.

groups.name: Sound like theory words
groups.why: Cord/chord, beet/beat, quay/key (a quay is a dock, said 'key'), peace/piece.

groups.name: Sound like instruments
groups.why: Liar/lyre, symbol/cymbal, base/bass, belle/bell.

groups.name: Things you sign
groups.why: All things you put your name on. Every song has a key signature, but none of these needs one.

groups.name: Perfect intervals
groups.why: Unison, 4th, 5th and octave are the perfect intervals. The tritone sits between the 4th and 5th and is not perfect.

groups.name: Units of time
groups.why: Time units. SECOND is also an interval, but not a perfect one, so it went back on the clock.

groups.name: ___ Minor
groups.why: Ursa Minor (the Little Dipper), Asia Minor (old name for Anatolia), and the constellations Canis Minor and Leo Minor.

groups.name: Words ending in -TONE
groups.why: Tritone = three whole steps. Baritone = the voice between tenor and bass. Monotone = one pitch. Keystone = the top stone of an arch.

groups.name: Major triads
groups.why: Major 3rd on the bottom, minor 3rd on top. D major needs F♯.

groups.name: Minor triads
groups.why: Minor 3rd on the bottom, major 3rd on top. E-G-B is minor. Flat that B and it turns diminished.

groups.name: Diminished triads
groups.why: Two stacked minor 3rds. B-D-F is the vii chord in C major.

groups.name: Augmented triads
groups.why: Two stacked major 3rds. E augmented is spelled E-G♯-B♯, not C: a 5th above E has to be a B of some kind.

groups.name: Dips
groups.why: Snack-table dips. None of them dance.

groups.name: Latin dances
groups.why: Tango (Argentina), samba (Brazil), rumba and mambo (Cuba). Count them in 2 or 4, not 3.

groups.name: Dances in 3/4
groups.why: All triple meter. Chopin wrote waltzes, mazurkas and polonaises, which is the trap.

groups.name: Chopin piano genres that are not dances
groups.why: Nocturne = night piece, etude = study, prelude = short opener, ballade = a story told in sound. Chopin wrote famous sets of all four.

groups.name: Pasta shapes
groups.why: Italian, yes. Musical, no. Pasta.

groups.name: Articulations
groups.why: Staccato = short and detached, legato = smooth and connected, tenuto = hold it full value, marcato = marked and strong.

groups.name: Road-map markings
groups.why: Da capo = back to the top, segno = the sign to jump back to, coda = the tail-end section, fine = the end. Repeat-sign GPS.

groups.name: Marks over letters
groups.why: Accent marks in writing: é, è, ü, ñ. GRAVE is also an Italian tempo marking meaning very slow and solemn.

groups.name: Baroque composers
groups.why: Roughly 1600 to 1750: Bach, Handel, Vivaldi (The Four Seasons) and Purcell, England's Baroque star.

groups.name: Classical-era composers
groups.why: Roughly 1750 to 1820. Haydn, Mozart, Salieri (Mozart's real-life colleague) and Gluck, who reformed opera.

groups.name: Romantic composers
groups.why: The 1800s: big feelings, big pianos. Chopin, Liszt, Brahms and Robert Schumann.

groups.name: 20th-century composers
groups.why: The Rite of Spring, Appalachian Spring, Rhapsody in Blue and Bartok's folk-powered piano music. All 1900s.

groups.name: Jazz trumpeters
groups.why: Louis Armstrong, Miles Davis, Dizzy Gillespie and Wynton Marsalis: four trumpet legends.

groups.name: Jazz saxophonists
groups.why: Charlie Parker, John Coltrane, Sonny Rollins and Stan Getz.

groups.name: Jazz nickname titles
groups.why: Duke Ellington, Count Basie, Lady Day (Billie Holiday) and King Oliver, Louis Armstrong's mentor.

groups.name: Instruments named after people
groups.why: Saxophone (Adolphe Sax), sousaphone (made for John Philip Sousa's band), Moog synthesizer (Robert Moog), theremin (Leon Theremin).

groups.name: The Beatles' first names
groups.why: Lennon, McCartney, Harrison and Starr.

groups.name: Beatles albums
groups.why: Studio albums: Beatles for Sale (1964), Rubber Soul (1965), Revolver (1966), Abbey Road (1969).

groups.name: Beatles songs that never named an album
groups.why: Famous Beatles songs, none of them an album title. Penny Lane is also a real street in Liverpool.

groups.name: Rolling Stones songs
groups.why: (I Can't Get No) Satisfaction (1965), Paint It Black (1966), Wild Horses (1971), Angie (1973). Different band, same British Invasion.

groups.name: Motown groups
groups.why: All Motown groups. The Commodores also launched Lionel Richie.

groups.name: Motown solo stars
groups.why: All recorded for Motown labels. Diana Ross went solo after the Supremes.

groups.name: Memphis soul on Stax
groups.why: Stax Records in Memphis was Motown's grittier rival: Otis Redding, Sam & Dave, Booker T. & the M.G.'s, Isaac Hayes.

groups.name: Detroit-raised stars who never recorded for Motown
groups.why: Aretha Franklin grew up in Detroit but recorded for Columbia and then Atlantic. Eminem, Jack White and Alice Cooper are Detroit too, nowhere near Motown.

groups.name: Country stars known by first name
groups.why: Reba McEntire, Dolly Parton, Shania Twain, Garth Brooks.

groups.name: Ben & Jerry's flavors
groups.why: Ice cream. Two are tributes: Cherry Garcia (Jerry Garcia of the Grateful Dead) and Phish Food (Phish).

groups.name: Grateful Dead songs
groups.why: Bertha (1971), Ripple and Truckin' (1970) and Althea (1980).

groups.name: Phish songs
groups.why: Wilson is from the Gamehendge saga. Cavern and Stash are on A Picture of Nectar. Ghost is from The Story of the Ghost.

groups.name: Toto songs
groups.why: All Toto. Their drummer, Jeff Porcaro, also played on Steely Dan records.

groups.name: Fleetwood Mac albums
groups.why: Rumours (1977), Tusk (1979), Mirage (1982), Tango in the Night (1987).

groups.name: Eagles albums
groups.why: Desperado (1973), On the Border (1974), Hotel California (1976), The Long Run (1979).

groups.name: Steely Dan albums
groups.why: Pretzel Logic (1974), Katy Lied (1975), Aja (1977), Gaucho (1980). Keyboard players study the chords on Aja like scripture.

groups.name: Chess pieces
groups.why: Chess. LORD sounds noble, but it is not on the board.

groups.name: Mary Poppins characters
groups.why: Mr. Banks, Bert the chimney sweep, and the Banks children, Jane and Michael.

groups.name: Jazz piano giants
groups.why: Thelonious Monk, Bill Evans, Art Tatum, Herbie Hancock. MONK is not a chess piece. The bishop is the church guy.

groups.name: Keyboardists: Doors, Yes, Deep Purple, Phish
groups.why: Ray Manzarek (Doors), Rick Wakeman (Yes), Jon Lord (Deep Purple), Page McConnell (Phish).

groups.name: Units of electricity
groups.why: Power, voltage, current, resistance. WATTS is also Charlie Watts of the Rolling Stones, but he is not in this drum lineup.

groups.name: American composers
groups.why: Aaron Copland (no E), George Gershwin, Leonard Bernstein, Charles Ives.

groups.name: Drummers: Led Zeppelin, The Who, Rush, The Police
groups.why: John Bonham, Keith Moon, Neil Peart, Stewart Copeland (with an E, unlike Aaron Copland).

groups.name: ___ kit
groups.why: First aid kit, tool kit, sewing kit, survival kit. The drum kit was hiding in plain sight.

groups.name: Taylor Swift songs
groups.why: Love Story (2008), Shake It Off and Blank Space (2014), Anti-Hero (2022).

groups.name: Electric ___
groups.why: Electric Slide (the dance), electric guitar, electric eel, and Electric Avenue (Eddy Grant).

groups.name: Songs titled with just a woman's name
groups.why: The Police, Dolly Parton, Derek and the Dominos, Elvis Costello. Come On Eileen has a name in it, but it is not just the name.

groups.name: Famous one-hit wonders in the US
groups.why: Los del Rio, Toni Basil, Soft Cell and Dexys Midnight Runners: each act's one giant US hit. Mickey is about a guy, which kept it off the name list.

groups.name: Bands with numbers
groups.why: Numbers in the name. Maroon 5 is still technically five-ish.

groups.name: Bands named after places
groups.why: Two cities and two states, all bands: Chicago (horns), Boston (More Than a Feeling), Kansas (Carry On Wayward Son), Alabama (country).

groups.name: Animal bands, spelled right
groups.why: The Eagles, The Turtles, Buddy Holly's Crickets and The Animals. Proper spelling.

groups.name: Animal bands, spelled wrong on purpose
groups.why: Beetles with a beat, Monkeys with double E, Birds with a Y, Gorillas with a Z.

groups.name: Pink ___
groups.why: Pink Panther, Pink Floyd, pink lemonade, pink flamingo. Henry Mancini wrote The Pink Panther theme.

groups.name: Muppets
groups.why: The Muppet Show crew. Animal is the band's drummer, and yes, he is a Muppet.

groups.name: Scored Jaws, The Lion King, The Simpsons, Good the Bad and the Ugly
groups.why: John Williams, Hans Zimmer, Danny Elfman, Ennio Morricone.

groups.name: Grammy firsts
groups.why: Mancini won the first Album of the Year (Peter Gunn, 1959). Modugno's Volare won the first Record of the Year. Bobby Darin was the first Best New Artist (1960). DJ Jazzy Jeff & the Fresh Prince won the first rap Grammy (1989).

groups.name: Peanuts characters
groups.why: Snoopy's bird pal got his name in 1970, from the festival. Schroeder is the Beethoven-loving toy-piano player.

groups.name: TV shows that premiered in 1969
groups.why: Scooby-Doo (Sept 13), The Brady Bunch (Sept 26), Monty Python's Flying Circus (Oct 5) and Sesame Street (Nov 10).

groups.name: Played Woodstock in 1969
groups.why: Jimi Hendrix closed the festival with The Star-Spangled Banner. Santana, Janis Joplin and Joan Baez were all on the bill.

groups.name: Missed Woodstock in 1969
groups.why: Bob Dylan lived in the town of Woodstock, NY, and still skipped it. The Doors and Led Zeppelin turned it down. Joni Mitchell wrote the song 'Woodstock' but stayed away for a TV booking.

groups.name: Shakespeare tragedies
groups.why: Tragedies. The Tempest is a late romance, which is why TEMPEST went to Beethoven.

groups.name: Symphony nicknames
groups.why: Haydn 94 (Surprise), Mozart 41 (Jupiter), Beethoven 3 (Eroica), Dvorak 9 (From the New World).

groups.name: Beethoven piano sonata nicknames
groups.why: Op. 27 No. 2 (Moonlight), Op. 57 (Appassionata), Op. 53 (Waldstein), Op. 31 No. 2 (Tempest).

groups.name: Chopin nicknames
groups.why: Minute Waltz (Op. 64 No. 1), Raindrop Prelude (Op. 28 No. 15), Revolutionary Etude (Op. 10 No. 12), Butterfly Etude (Op. 25 No. 9).

groups.name: Songs with a day of the week
groups.why: The Bangles, the Rolling Stones, Katy Perry and Maroon 5.

groups.name: Days in Spanish
groups.why: Monday, Tuesday, Saturday, Sunday. Placido Domingo, the opera tenor, says hi.

groups.name: Songs with a month
groups.why: Earth, Wind & Fire, Guns N' Roses, The Four Seasons (Oh, What a Night) and U2.

groups.name: Days are named after them
groups.why: Saturday (Saturn), Monday (Moon), Sunday (Sun), Thursday (Thor's day).

groups.name: Disney songs
groups.why: Frozen, The Little Mermaid, Moana, Beauty and the Beast.

groups.name: Beatles songs
groups.why: All Beatles. Yellow Submarine lives under the sea too, but the Little Mermaid got there first.

groups.name: Pixar movies
groups.why: Pixar. Coco is the one about a boy who wants to play guitar.

groups.name: Taylor Swift albums
groups.why: Red (2012), Lover (2019), folklore (2020), Midnights (2022).

groups.name: BTS songs
groups.why: Dynamite and Butter (2020, 2021) were their English-language smashes. Idol and Fake Love came in 2018.

groups.name: Maroon 5 songs
groups.why: Payphone (2012), Animals and Sugar (2014), Memories (2019).

groups.name: Olivia Rodrigo songs
groups.why: drivers license, deja vu and good 4 u (2021), vampire (2023).

groups.name: Billie Eilish songs
groups.why: ocean eyes (2016), lovely with Khalid (2018), bad guy (2019), Happier Than Ever (2021).

groups.name: Video game heroes
groups.why: Nintendo's Mario, Link and Kirby, plus Sega's Sonic. Sonic also means 'about sound', but here he just runs fast.

groups.name: Greek myth figures
groups.why: Orpheus is the legendary musician whose playing could charm rocks and trees.

groups.name: Music streaming services
groups.why: All streaming apps. Pandora is also the myth figure with the box, which is the trap.

groups.name: Hidden instruments
groups.why: HARPoon, HORNet, VIOLAte, TOMato (a tom is a drum).

groups.name: One-name singers
groups.why: First names or stage names, no last names needed.

groups.name: Stage surnames from outer space
groups.why: Bruno Mars, Freddie Mercury, Ringo Starr (two Rs) and Keith Moon.

groups.name: Words hiding a one-name singer
groups.why: teaCHER, PINKy (P!nk), SEALant, PRINCEss.

groups.name: Real first names: Sting, Bono, Elton John, Lady Gaga
groups.why: Gordon Sumner, Paul Hewson, Reginald Dwight, Stefani Germanotta. Not Gwen.

groups.name: Silverware
groups.why: Metal utensils. Chopsticks are not silverware, and today they are a song.

groups.name: Coffee drinks
groups.why: Coffee. Sabrina Carpenter's 2024 hit Espresso made the first one a herring.

groups.name: Songs named for fruit
groups.why: Justin Bieber, Harry Styles, Fats Domino and The Runaways.

groups.name: First songs piano students learn
groups.why: Three notes, then Beethoven's Ninth, then the holidays, then the duet everyone plays. They sound like snacks, they are songs.

groups.name: Kinds of candy
groups.why: Sweets. Lollipop is also a 1958 hit for the Chordettes.

groups.name: ___man superheroes
groups.why: Batman, Spider-Man, Ant-Man, Aquaman.

groups.name: Avengers' first names
groups.why: Tony Stark, Steve Rogers, Bruce Banner, Natasha Romanoff. BRUCE could be Springsteen, but not today.

groups.name: ___ Man songs
groups.why: Piano Man (Billy Joel), Rocket Man (Elton John), Soul Man (Sam & Dave), Macho Man (Village People).

groups.name: Dog breeds
groups.why: Dogs. Snoopy is a beagle.

groups.name: Sesame Street pals (no grouches)
groups.why: Sesame Street friends. Oscar the Grouch lives there too, but he left for an awards show.

groups.name: Broadway musicals
groups.why: Hamilton, Wicked, Cats, Annie. CATS was never going to be a dog breed.

groups.name: The EGOT
groups.why: Emmy (TV), Grammy (music), Oscar (film), Tony (theater). Win all four and you have an EGOT.

groups.name: Vivaldi's Four Seasons
groups.why: Vivaldi's four violin concertos from 1725. Donna Summer is a different season.

groups.name: Music biopic titles
groups.why: Elton John (2019), Ray Charles (2004), Elvis Presley (2022), Johnny Cash (2005).

groups.name: Acts with a royal title in the name
groups.why: Bands and artists named like royalty.

groups.name: King of Pop, Queen of Soul, Queen of Disco, King of Swing
groups.why: Royal nicknames earned on the charts, not in a castle.

groups.name: PAW Patrol pups
groups.why: Police pup, fire pup, flying pup, construction pup.

groups.name: Bluey's family
groups.why: Bluey, her sister Bingo, Dad (Bandit) and Mum (Chilli). Chilli is a mum, not a pepper.

groups.name: Famous blue characters (no dogs)
groups.why: A Smurf, a hedgehog, Aladdin's Genie and a cookie fan. Bluey is blue too, but she is a dog.

groups.name: Pepper varieties
groups.why: Named pepper varieties, from medium (jalapeno) to very hot (ghost pepper).

groups.name: Baby Shark's family (not the baby)
groups.why: Doo doo doo doo doo doo. Baby is busy on an album cover.

groups.name: Flat 2D shapes
groups.why: Flat shapes. A prism is 3D, and the triangle is also an instrument.

groups.name: ___ crossing
groups.why: Animal Crossing (the game), railroad crossing, border crossing, zebra crossing (the British name for a crosswalk).

groups.name: On famous album covers
groups.why: Pink Floyd's Dark Side of the Moon (prism), The Velvet Underground & Nico (banana), Nirvana's Nevermind (baby), The Beatles' Abbey Road (crosswalk).

groups.name: Songs with numbers (not albums)
groups.why: Taylor Swift, Ariana Grande, Dolly Parton and Nena. 22 looked like an Adele age. It is a Taylor single.

groups.name: Jersey numbers: Jordan, Gretzky, Robinson, Brady
groups.why: Michael Jordan 23, Wayne Gretzky 99, Jackie Robinson 42 (retired across all of MLB), Tom Brady 12.

groups.name: Number albums: Swift, Bruno Mars, Prince, Van Halen
groups.why: 1989 (Taylor Swift, 2014), 24K Magic (Bruno Mars, 2016), 1999 (Prince, 1982), 1984 (Van Halen, 1984).

groups.name: Classic movie monsters
groups.why: Monsters. Frankenstrat is a guitar. Frankenstein's monster is busy.

groups.name: Famous racehorses
groups.why: Racing legends. Trigger was a famous horse too, but a movie horse, not a racehorse.

groups.name: Songs Eric Clapton sang
groups.why: Layla (with Derek and the Dominos), Wonderful Tonight (1977), Tears in Heaven (1992), Change the World (1996).

groups.name: Famous guitars with names
groups.why: B.B. King's Lucille, Eric Clapton's Blackie, Willie Nelson's Trigger, Eddie Van Halen's Frankenstrat.
